rules.name: package-versions in SemVer order
rules.bug: package-versions has no sort order: versions come back in whatever order the query plan reads them. The new service returns them in SemVer order, oldest first, the order NuGet clients expect (spec 02b, bug 1).
evidence: NuGetGallery 63e6ee42, src/NuGetGallery/Queries/AutocompleteDatabasePackageVersionsQuery.cs line 46: var versions = query.Select(p => p.Version).ToList(); the query has no OrderBy.
The old app's SQL, read from its plan cache by the recording run (record-outputs artifact, old-app-sql.txt): SELECT [Extent1].[Version] ... with no ORDER BY.
recordings/state-a, GET /api/v2/package-versions/Serilog: ["1.4.128","1.3.30","4.4.0"], push order rather than version order.
